thread:
maria_support: Heads up — LAURA_CORP is seeing sustained 5xx/timeouts from hosted inference since ~09:05 PDT. Customer reports long tail P95/P99 and API 502s. They provided request IDs and a short repro. :fire_engine:

dan_sre: Investigating now. Any recent deploys? What region/cluster?

maria_support: No deploys from customer side. Region: us-west-2, model: gpt-open-16k-v1 (hosted). Sample request id: req_20260304_98765. They said spike started after a billing auth refresh yesterday.

ashley_eng-runtime: Pulling traces. Early hypothesis: continuous-batcher backlog + repeated client retries due to transient auth failures -> queue saturation + long tail latency. Can we get queue depth and batching metrics for the tenant?

maria_support: Attached bits from customer — they show a 401 on initial token then retries, then 502s.

laura_customer: our logs show token refresh returned 500 for a short period, so our SDK retried 3x immediately, then backed off but by then your queue length was high and we started seeing timeouts. Here's the curl we used to reproduce:```
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer <temp-token>" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"model":"gpt-open-16k-v1","input":"short prompt","timeout":120000}'
```

dan_sre: Thanks. I'm seeing tenant_queue_length spike to 820 (queue_capacity 256) around 09:07 in the host logs. Continuous-batcher backlog grew; worker batch latency jumped. Relevant extract:```
[09:07:12] queue_len=820 tenant_id=laura-corp host=hw-12
[09:07:13] batching: pending_batches=34 avg_batch_size=18
[09:07:15] dequeue_delay=310ms kv_cache_spinup=full
[09:07:18] request_timeout=120s -> enforced deadline 30s
```

ashley_eng-runtime: That kv_cache_spinup jump is suspicious — cold KV cache coroutine spin caused per-request setup to blow up. Combined with many retries it will push dequeue latency past soft deadlines. Also seeing many 502s from the gateway layer in that time window.

maria_support: Customer wants SLA credit and root cause + repro steps so they can validate fix.

dan_sre: Immediate mitigations I'd propose:
1) Apply tenant-level rate limiting / circuit breaker to stop retry storms (drop excessive retries).
2) Short-term: bump tenant queue_capacity for laura-corp to 1024 on the affected pool and enable burst workers.
3) Fix auth token refresh handling to avoid 500->retries cascade.

ashley_eng-runtime: Agreed. Also recommend tuning batching config: lower max_batch_wait to reduce queuing (trade throughput for tail latency) and enable aggressive prefix caching for this model. Patch config:```yaml
continuous_batcher:
  max_batch_wait_ms: 15  # from 50
  max_batch_size: 24
kvcache:
  prewarm_on_high_queue: true
```

billing_bob: Noted the customer mentioned "billing auth refresh" — did they hit a billing API outage that returned 500 on token mint? I can confirm billing system had a transient 500 at 08:58 for 70s in us-west-2. That aligns. We'll coordinate postmortem with payments.

maria_support: Can we get a reproducible minimal test to show queue saturation? Customer test script below (they provided):```python
import requests
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor

def call_once(i):
    r = requests.post('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate', headers={'Authorization': 'Bearer BAD-TOKEN-OR-EXPIRED'}, json={'model':'gpt-open-16k-v1','input':'hi'})
    print(i, r.status_code)

with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=200) as e:
    for i in range(400):
        e.submit(call_once, i)
```

ashley_eng-runtime: That will reproduce the retry storm locally. Repro steps we should document for the customer postmortem:
- Step 1: run above script against us-west-2 with tokens that intermittently 500 on refresh.
- Step 2: observe queue_len metric cross capacity and continuous-batcher latency climb in perf dashboard.
- Step 3: verify that after circuit breaker triggers, P95/P99 recover.

dan_sre: I'm going to patch a tenant-level immediate throttle and enqueue a dedicated burst pod for laura-corp. Applying now.

sre-bot: Action: tenant_throttle applied for tenant=laura-corp by user=dan_sre at 1763811300.

deploy-bot: Deploying runtime config changes (batcher max_wait) to us-west-2 pool. Canarying 5% first.

maria_support: Laura, we'll coordinate a maintenance window to temporarily raise queue capacity and run your repro while we harden auth refresh. We'll also open a billing incident link once Bob shares summary.

laura_customer: appreciate quick response — please share steps we should run after you apply mitigations so we can confirm.

ashley_eng-runtime: After we apply throttle + batcher tweak, please run the python script for 2 minutes and attach your SDK logs. Also include client-side retry timings. If you can reproduce after fixes, send logs and we'll close the loop.

billing_bob: I'll own the billing postmortem. Initial RCA: transient token mint 500 from payments service caused client retries -> increased ingress and continuous-batcher backlog -> tail latency/timeouts and gateway 5xx. Will share timeline.

maria_support: Closing loop items for the postmortem: (1) timeline of token errors, (2) queue and batcher metrics, (3) config changes made (batcher max_wait, tenant_capacity bump, throttle), (4) customer repro script and results, (5) follow-up fix for token refresh handling.

laura_customer: thanks all. We'll test after mitigation and report back. :white_check_mark:
